name: Mr. Rainer
source:
Starts off with introducing himself as Ülar's life coach at the beginning. Assists our Ülar for most of the common route.

[spoiler]Ends up mysteriously disappearing partway to the common route, but is seen again in the true route chatting amicably with the other Ülar.[/spoiler]

[spoiler] His true identity is a voicebank used for announcements in DOME AINU. [/spoiler]
